paper_role: individual-behaviour-adjacent mechanism gate following the frozen lagged redistribution and performance-memory results
known_before_freeze: Palmer relative reproductive performance predicts within-island redistribution at lag 2 and lag 3 under the fixed-specification validation.
Relative reproductive performance has weak one- to two-year autocorrelation.
Past performance retains incremental information for lag-2 redistribution after contemporaneous performance, outcome-interval group size and colony fixed effects.

Historical Palmer methods state that breeding-adult arrival chronology on Humble Island was observed approximately every two days from early October to mid-November and that returning banded birds were searched for throughout the field season.
The public arrival table has fields corresponding to study season, date, island, colony and adult count.

exposure_boundary.example_rows_seen: A public teaching page exposed several PAL9192 Humble colony counts from 1991-10-20 while confirming the table schema.
exposure_boundary.consequence: This is prospectively frozen with respect to the derived colony-season arrival outcomes and their association with prior reproductive performance, but not literally blind to every raw arrival value.

source.title: Adelie penguin breeding population arrival chronology on Humble Island, 1991-2024
source.historical_sampling_protocol: breeding-adult population arrival observed approximately once every two days on Humble Island from early October through about 15 November, as ice and weather permitted
source.execution_rule: Use the frozen EDI package revision 8 or a byte-identical public mirror. Record the exact entity identifier, URL and SHA256 before outcome computation. Fail closed if required columns or the package identity cannot be verified.

season_and_join.arrival_season: Parse season_start_year from study identifier PALYYZZ using the same century and consecutive-year validation rules as PALMER_CHICK_SEASON_KEY_RESOLUTION_V1.
season_and_join.performance_predictor_season: S_i,t from the chick-production season t.
season_and_join.arrival_outcome_season: arrival chronology in the next breeding season t+1.

arrival_metric.window: Use observations from October 1 through November 15 inclusive in each study season.
eligibility: At least 5 finite nonnegative adult-count observations in the arrival window.
The first and last eligible observation dates must be separated by at least 10 calendar days.
arrival_metric.monotone_envelope: Sort by date, collapse exact duplicate colony-date rows only if adult counts are identical, otherwise fail closed; define M(d) as the cumulative maximum adult count observed up to date d.
arrival_metric.normalization: Q(d) = M(d) / max_d M(d) within colony-season.
arrival_metric.primary_t50: First date at which Q(d) >= 0.50, linearly interpolated in calendar-day units between the immediately preceding and crossing observations when the preceding Q < 0.50.
arrival_metric.within_season_relative_metric: For each season, subtract the mean eligible-colony t50 from each colony t50. Negative values indicate earlier-than-average arrival on Humble that season.
arrival_metric.reason: Within-season centering removes year-common phenology shifts due to regional sea ice and weather; normalization removes absolute colony-size differences.

P5_prior_performance_to_arrival.question: Does relatively high reproductive performance in colony i during season t predict earlier breeding-adult return to that same Humble colony in season t+1?
P5_prior_performance_to_arrival.predictor: S_i,t, exactly as frozen in PALMER_PERFORMANCE_REDISTRIBUTION_LAGS_V2, restricted to Humble colonies.
P5_prior_performance_to_arrival.model: relative_t50_i,t+1 = alpha * S_i,t + gamma * z_log_adult_pairs_i,t + colony_code fixed effect + error
P5_prior_performance_to_arrival.prior_size: z-standardize log1p adult breeding-pair census at colony i in season t within Humble-season before fitting.

inference.null: Conditional on season, observed prior performance scores are exchangeable among eligible Humble colonies with respect to next-season arrival timing.
inference.permutation: Permute S_i,t within predictor season t while holding arrival outcomes, prior size, colony fixed effects and missingness fixed.
inference.p_value: one-sided lower-tail Monte Carlo p with +1 correction

P5_prior_performance_to_arrival.decision: supported if fitted alpha < 0 and one-sided permutation p <= 0.05

P6_timing_specificity.question: If past performance changes return/settlement timing rather than merely scaling the whole arrival curve, is the association visible by the midpoint and not confined to a single arbitrary threshold?

sensitivities.t25: Repeat P5 with within-season centered t25; expected alpha < 0.
sensitivities.t75: Repeat P5 with within-season centered t75; expected alpha < 0.
sensitivities.arrival_span: Report t75 - t25 and test no directional hypothesis; this distinguishes timing shift from simple compression/expansion of the arrival period.

P6_timing_specificity.coherence_rule: Primary P5 is considered timing-coherent if alpha has the same negative sign for both t25 and t75. Their p-values are sensitivity descriptors and do not replace the primary t50 decision.

mechanism_interpretation.if_supported: Prior reproductive performance predicts a pre-breeding demographic response before the current season's reproductive outcome is known. This strengthens a short-term retention/return/settlement interpretation relative to a purely post-breeding abundance artifact.
mechanism_interpretation.if_not_supported: Do not use arrival timing as evidence that the lagged redistribution signal is carried by returning adults or prospectors.
cannot_distinguish: the same adults returning earlier versus different adults settling there
social information use versus an unmeasured persistent colony-specific cue

sensitivities.minimum_observations_7: Require at least 7 arrival observations per colony-season.
sensitivities.leave_one_colony_out: Report the observed P5 alpha after removing each Humble colony with at least 5 matched predictor-outcome seasons.
sensitivities.alternate_performance_metric: Repeat P5 using the frozen logratio reproductive-performance metric.
sensitivities.current_performance_bridge: Descriptive only: among rows with S_i,t+1 available, add S_i,t+1 to P5. Because current-season performance occurs after arrival, this is not a causal adjustment and cannot replace the primary model.

claim_boundaries: Do not call adult counts individual resight data.
Do not infer individual movement, immigration, prospecting, philopatry or public-information use from colony-level arrival counts.
Do not alter the arrival window, threshold, monotone-envelope rule, centering, controls or permutation scheme after derived arrival outcomes are opened.
Do not use t25 or t75 to rescue a failed t50 primary endpoint.
A supported result identifies pre-breeding timing as a carrier of temporal information, not the identity of the birds carrying it.
